PlanToys is a manufacturing company located in Bangkok, Thailand, employing 11-50 people. The company produces educational toys for various developmental stages, emphasizing environmental and social responsibility and high ethical standards. PlanToys uses non-toxic, natural materials such as organic rubberwood in its products to promote safe play and a closer connection to nature.
